## About me

My work sits at the intersection of creative communication and measurable performance. I enjoy translating complex data into useful stories, designing systems that are easy to use, and helping mission-driven teams make better digital decisions.

I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Digital Marketing at Cal Poly Pomona while collaborating with Wellness Ranch Therapy on a culminating experience project focused on SEO, analytics, website performance, and Google Ad Grants readiness.
